credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Nine (9) color card paint samples arranged in layers representing an array of earth tones. The nine individual hues range from beige to yellow ochre to reddish brown ochre's. Handwritten in pencil are color notations on four (4) of the color cards.  Each color test was executed on an individual square of cardboard or heavy paper.  The squares, about 3" on average, present individual samples of saturated color.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Addison Doty
title: Color Cards, Shades of Earth Tones
